bio: Situated in a small courtyard belonging to Zagreb’s youth theatre (ZKM), this young, lively restaurant boasts a bold colour scheme and retro furnishings, with an open-view kitchen and a veranda (the best seats are here). The extensive menu features classic French and Italian dishes alongside more creative options that pay tribute to local cuisine. Starters include fresh fish from the Adriatic, while the Beef Wellington is considered to be one of the chef’s specialities. The excellent wine list includes labels from all over Croatia – make sure you ask for recommendations. Don’t miss the charming outdoor space in summer....
